overview_description.description:
Gulf International Bank offers a diverse range of financial products and services and banking solutions to a wide customer. This includes corporate banking, the world’s first Shariah-compliant digital retail banking service, meem, as well as investment banking spanning asset management, bond and Sukuk issuance, financial restructuring, private placements, private sale, IPOs, underwriting equity and debt, and mergers and acquisitions.

Gulf International Bank B.S.C. (GIB) is a pan GCC universal bank established in 1975 and regulated by the Central Bank of Bahrain.

about_short_description.short_description: Gulf International Bank offers a diverse range of financial products and services and banking solutions to a wide customer.

product.name: Corporate Banking Services
product.description: Provides tailored banking solutions and credit products to corporate clients, including working capital financing and other credit needs.

product.name: Project and Structured Finance
product.description: Provides financing and guarantees for large-scale projects and structured transactions, especially in sectors like energy, infrastructure, and transportation.

product.name: Syndicated Lending and Agency Services
product.description: Arranges and distributes syndicated credit facilities for large infrastructure projects and corporate clients, coordinating between borrowers and lenders.

product.name: International Operations Services
product.description: Offers global cash management and trade finance solutions, including multi-currency accounts and payment services to support international trade.

product.name: Sharia-Compliant Banking Products
product.description: Delivers financial solutions compliant with Islamic law, including project finance, syndicated lending, trade finance, and capital market advisory.

product.name: Treasury and Risk Mitigation Solutions
product.description: Provides customized hedging and investment strategies covering interest rates, foreign exchange, and commodities to manage financial risks.
